title: Lesson 17: Failure Modes & Resilience — js-tools
desc: A system taking itself down with its own traffic, measured in numbers: a three-tier chain where each tier retries three times turns 30 user requests into 810 hits on the leaf service — exactly 27 times, and no tier did anything wrong; a 10% retry budget brings that down to 69; backoff without jitter bursts to 19.6 times the average while jitter keeps it to 5.3 times and finishes sooner; a circuit breaker turns 5,291 ms of waiting into 2,173 ms; and a timeout placed in the wrong spot makes the server do 50,000 ms of wasted work while the dashboard stays green.
